full_page.content:
1928. September
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 4.
Page 39 Cont.
Sept. 26 Baby 2 mo. - Sick Vomiting Dr. Stockler ... Wyomissing, Pa. - Exima - $25.00
10 mo. Baby - double pneumonia - Carlyn Chartier - Mt Clement Non-Cath. Art. Johnson - Cancer of R. Operation Friday - Prayers .- Mrs. Weil, lost two daughters - one being drowned - nearly crazy - Come Wednesdays for 9 months.
Mrs. Core - seriously ill from operation
Page 40 Wm. Cummings of Pittsburgh, Pa. awaiting Hospital operation for lump on his heart was Enrolled.
Mrs. Edna Egan, non Cath. & blind - came and enrolled June 27 - has come every Wed. since. Now sees perfectly and wants to become Cath- olic - Mother has financial trouble asks for prayers.
Sept. 27th Mrs. Mary Stone 53, 2158 Hurlbut Ave. - five living children. Sick- ly off and on for five years with pain in right side. She has doc- tored with M.Ds. & an Osteopath and Enrolled a few times as annual member. To-day
Page 41
Oct. 3 Willie LaFave - cripple Boy - 5 yrs. T. Jeakle - folks fear an unfortunate Marriage ....?? Mr. Sullivan (Cancer) Houghton
Mrs. Rose Miller (Providence Hosp. ) 67 yrs. - Very gangrenous - some- times delerious - yet nearly always praying ...
Mrs. T. - Tubercular - very Sick Thos. Halligan 5 of Flint - lye in Boy' Eyes Genevieve Hurley - Bay City 4/8/'8 Raymond Clancy 24 - to be ordained next Feb. hopeless with diabetes Enrolled July 5th - three days after was O.K.
